description: A kitchen counter vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a corner section of a dark moody kitchen where matte black-painted cabinetry with brushed silver round knobs meets white subway tile backsplash and a white marble countertop with soft grey veining. The window in the center background looks out onto a snowy winter landscape of bare birch trees, the daylight flat and grey-white. Dark upper cabinets frame the window, adorned with a holiday garland of fresh pine, red berries, and gold ornament balls. On the left section of the counter, a polished brass stockpot with lid sits near fresh pine branch sprigs and red berries. To the right of the centerpiece a matte black utensil crock holds wooden spoons and silicone spatulas, and gold-lidded cylindrical canisters sit further along. The countertop centerpiece is a large Christmas-tree-shaped decorative globe with a gold star finial, housing a snowman scene with glitter swirl inside. A warm internal glow from the piece radiates softly onto the marble surface around it. The mood is festive, cozy, and high-contrast — a holiday kitchen still life in black, gold, and white.
